summary_en: This study tests amivantamab alone and with standard chemotherapy in adults with advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer. Amivantamab is given as an intravenous infusion, with the dose based on body weight; when given alone, it is given on Days 1 and 15 of Cycle 2 of 28-day cycles, and when combined, it is given with mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI chemotherapy in 28-day cycles. The study measures anti-tumor activity, the recommended phase 2 combination dose, and safety.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba amivantamab solo y junto con quimioterapia estándar en adultos con cáncer colorrectal avanzado o metastásico. Amivantamab se administra por infusión intravenosa, con una dosis según el peso corporal; cuando se usa solo, se da los días 1 y 15 del ciclo 2 de ciclos de 28 días, y cuando se combina, se da con quimioterapia mFOLFOX6 o FOLFIRI en ciclos de 28 días. El estudio mide la actividad antitumoral, la dosis recomendada de combinación para fase 2 y la seguridad.
who_for: Unresectable or metastatic colon or rectal adenocarcinoma.
Tumor previously found to be wild-type for KRAS, NRAS, and BRAF, without HER2 amplification.
Measurable disease (phase 2) or evaluable disease (phase 1b dose confirmation); tumor amenable to biopsy.
not_for: Identified KRAS, NRAS, BRAF, or EGFR mutation, or HER2 amplification, on central ctDNA testing (cohort-specific).
History or known presence of leptomeningeal disease.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy (childbearing potential).
Investigator judges participation not in the participant's best interest.
